items.quote: Manny is genuinely a great guy who really cares about his customers and the work he does. He worked incredibly hard, including through some absolutely brutal Florida heat, and you can tell he takes what he does personally and truly wants to do right by people. We really appreciate all of his effort and the kind of person he is. Definitely someone worth supporting!

He showed up the next day after my original tree person did not show up, so I reached out to Mannys Trees & multi Service, and he was very responsive and professional. He did a great job on my queen palm and offered a good price for trimming. Highly recommend Mannys for palm tree trimming!

We are completely satisfied with the services provided by Manny! His company offers competitive pricing and amazing work! The Work completed was done efficiently and completely cleaned of debris! Small businesses ROCK! We will definitely be continuing to use his services!
